summary_claims.claim: Public entities must create an AI and automated decision tool policy requiring a human to make any final decision
Training on the appropriate use of such tools and disciplinary procedure for violations

note: The effective date 2025-08-05 rests on Attorney General Opinion 2025-032, stored from ag-opinions.s3.amazonaws.com, which the script counts as secondary (host not recorded as official); it is consistent with the Act having no emergency clause. A person should decide on the host. No 2026 amendment found.
